description: This file appears to be a script responsible for detecting scope changes in a project based on file modifications, specifically for CI/CD automation purposes. It includes regular expressions for matching paths, functions to list changed paths using git, and logic to decide which parts of the project need to be rebuilt or tested based on those changes.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Determines which parts of the project need to be built or tested based on an array of changed file paths.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Uses git to list the paths of files changed between the provided base and head commits.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Writes the scope detection results to the GitHub Actions output file.
